name: Podman in Podman
description: Runs a Podman engine in the dev container. The remote user runs rootless Podman, and sudo runs rootful Podman.

buildah.description: Install buildah from the distribution archive.

skopeo.description: Install skopeo from the distribution archive.

compose.description: Compose tool. podman-compose runs the podman command and needs no API service. It is the compose provider of 'podman compose' and, with dockerCompat, of 'docker compose'.

dockerCompat.description: Install podman-docker (a docker command that runs podman), start a rootful Podman API service at container start, and link /var/run/docker.sock to its socket (root:docker 0660). No Docker CLI is installed. When docker-in-docker, docker-outside-of-docker or a different docker command is present, the install skips this option.
